name: alt-clicky
description: A chrome browser extension to copy preformatted text.

scripts.build: web-ext build --overwrite-dest --filename alt-clicky.xpi --ignore-files node_modules "package*.json" img README.md AGENTS.md test update_ff_src.sh
scripts.install:ff: npm run build && open -a "Firefox Developer Edition" web-ext-artifacts/alt-clicky.xpi
